text.text_excerpt: The place is going hard for atmosphere, and it is cavernous and retro, with partially exposed brick walls. I got very attentive service while I was there, at an off-peak time. Their menu of waffles and other breakfast delights yielded for me a slightly caky waffle with nutella and bananas. The bananas were not fresh but had been sautéed or something beforehand; personally I find waffles (or pancakes/pastries/etc.) plenty crusty enough on their own and I much prefer the taste of fresh fruit on them. The waffle itself was a delicious indulgence. The syrup on the side didn't add much, surprisingly. All told, I was satisfied that I spent my unexpected break that day well. I might try another ...

I've eaten here twice so far. Once was Uber Eats and once was dine-in. The first time was a three star and the second was a four star. I really want to go back so I'm rounding up the average! The first time, when I got Uber Eats, my croissant sandwich was burnt. Sad face. The middle was still yummy so I peeled off as much of the char as I could and moved on. The potatoes on the side were bland. No biggie, I'm a big girl and can add salt and pepper. Problems solved, buuut problems nonetheless. The second meal I had from there was so so tasty. That savory waffle tho. YUM. Perfectly cooked bacon and overeasy eggs over the *best* waffle I've ever eaten. Gimme dat maple syrup on the side too! ...

Pretty new place but the service was great! It's a really cute place and I loved how it looks. We were greeted right as we walked in by someone, presumably a manager or so, and he made us feel welcome and asked how we were doing. I was expecting a little more from the food (I love a good hollandaise sauce), but the service was so great that I'd be willing to come back here anytime.
